code: SELECT region, is_wholesale, is_vip, qty, price_cents, coupon FROM orders

gross = qty * price_cents
base = 10 if is_wholesale * qty >= 20 else 0
vipd = 5 if is_vip > 0 else 0
rate = max(base, vipd) + 3 * coupon
discount = round(gross * rate / 100)
net = gross - discount
tax = round(net * 12 / 100)
total = net + tax

title: Orders by region
group: region
count: orders
sum: gross discount tax total
money: gross discount tax total
